title: BEST-OF-N JAILBREAKING
reasoning: The paper describes a black-box automated red-teaming method (jailbreaking) to test the robustness of frontier AI models across different modalities. While it evaluates whether models can be prompted to bypass safety (which includes ethical filters against harmful content), the focus is on the attack methodology and its scaling laws, rather than a primary study or benchmark of religion, morals, or ethical systems.
